title: Hold registration to work with vulnerable people
what: People engaging in regulated activities with children must be registered to work with vulnerable people.

laws.title: Registration to Work with Vulnerable People Act 2013 (Tas)

sources.title: Registration to Work with Vulnerable People Act 2013 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person who is required to be registered to engage in a regulated activity, but is not so registered with a registration in a category of registration allowing engagement in that regulated activity in relation to the class of vulnerable persons to whom that category of registration relates, must not engage in the regulated activity knowing, or with reckless disregard as to whether or not, he or she – (a) is engaging in the regulated activity;

reach.note: Schools, child care, and sport, arts and tutoring instruction.

assessment.summary: People doing child-related work need the state or territory's working with children check.

marks.reason: Checks and their renewal for staff and volunteers in child-related work.
A check from one state is generally not valid in another, so people working across borders need several.
